import numpy as np
import torch
from actuator import Actuator
from teacher import stage, stage_cost
from solution import heat, lift, policy_cost

torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)
w = torch.tensor(2.4, requires_grad=True)
p = torch.tensor([[-.2, .7], [.3, 1.1], [.9, -.4]])
h = dict(C=185., G=3.2, time_scale_min=2.5, time_origin_min=9., y_shift_C=33., y_scale_K=11., Ta_C=21.)
def field(zp):
    return w * zp[:, :1].square() + zp[:, 1:2]
z, power = p[:, :1], p[:, 1:2]
residual = heat(field, p, h)
expected = 185 * 11 * 2*w*z/150 + 3.2*(33 + 11*(w*z.square()+power)-21) - 1000*power
torch.testing.assert_close(residual, expected)
torch.testing.assert_close(torch.autograd.grad(residual.sum(), w)[0], (185*11*2*z/150 + 3.2*11*z.square()).sum())
assert heat(field, p, {}) is None and heat(field, p, {'C': 1}) is None
assert not p.requires_grad

rng = np.random.default_rng(182)
for N in (1, 2, 7, 11):
    for _ in range(10):
        pars = dict(zip(('a','b','c','d','g'), rng.uniform(-1,1,5)))
        initial = rng.normal(size=3)
        du = rng.normal(size=N)
        obj = Actuator(pars, *initial[:2])
        ys = [obj.step(u) for u in initial[2] + np.cumsum(du)]
        F,P = lift(pars, N)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(F@initial+P@du, ys, atol=1e-12, rtol=1e-12)

cfg = dict(N=5, beta=.3, a=.7, b=.5, limit=1.5, center=.15, scale=.8, q=2., r=.3, s=.27, discount=.92)
x = torch.tensor([[-.3],[.6],[3.]])
ref = torch.tensor([[.1],[.15],[-.2]])
prev = torch.tensor([[-.2],[.13],[.49]])
alpha = torch.tensor(.58, requires_grad=True)
def actor(v):
    return alpha*v[:,:1]+.23*v[:,1:]
def model(v):
    return .1*v[:,:1]-.2*v[:,1:]
def scalar_oracle(weight, coupled):
    costs = []
    for state, target, last in zip(x.flatten().tolist(), ref.flatten().tolist(), prev.flatten().tolist()):
        total=0.
        for k in range(cfg['N']):
            nxt, applied=stage(lambda v: weight*v[0]+.23*v[1], state, target, last, cfg)
            if coupled:
                nxt += .1*state-.2*applied
            total+=cfg['discount']**k*stage_cost(nxt, target, applied, last, cfg)
            state, last=nxt, applied
        costs.append(total)
    return np.mean(costs)
for coupled in (False, True):
    value=policy_cost(actor, model if coupled else None, x, ref, prev, cfg, coupled)
    assert value.ndim == 0
    np.testing.assert_allclose(value.item(), scalar_oracle(.58, coupled), rtol=1e-12)
    diff=(scalar_oracle(.580001,coupled)-scalar_oracle(.579999,coupled))/2e-6
    np.testing.assert_allclose(torch.autograd.grad(value, alpha)[0].item(), diff, rtol=1e-6)
print('thermal value and gradient, MPC rollouts, policy values and gradients passed')
'@ | & 'D:\projects\control-agent-harness\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -B -
